Akutní:chronická zátěž. Demoted na konte: Acute:chronic load. Demoted to context — in runners it doesn't predict on its own. >1.5 elevated, <0.7 sudden drop.

Dolní končetina / běžecké přetížení. Brá: Lower limb / running overload. Gate for the recurrence bonuses.
Fades 1–4 weeks after a big jump.
Drift doby kontaktu se zemí (normalizová: Ground contact time drift (normalised to cadence). Dead zone 0.2, weight 13.
Drift kadence. Klesající kadence (záporn: Cadence drift. Falling cadence (negative z) is the risk direction. Dead zone 0.2, weight 10.
Drift vertikální oscilace. Mrtvá zóna 0,: Vertical oscillation drift. Dead zone 0.2, weight 10.
Drift vertikálního poměru proti vaší nor: Vertical ratio drift vs your norm (terrain-adjusted). Dead zone 0.2, z ceiling = 4, weight 17.
Fitness (42d) − akutní zátěž, poměrem k: Fitness (42d) − acute load, as a ratio to chronic. Negative = acute is outpacing what has been built.
Fyzioterapeutem potvrzené zranění (grade: Injury confirmed by a physiotherapist (grade A, higher ceiling).
HRV za 7 dní ≥ 1,5 SD nad normou a zárov: HRV over 7 days ≥ 1.5 SD above the norm together with fatigue in the check-in or a higher heart rate at pace.
Klesající sebehodnocení po trénincích (≥: Declining post-session self-rating (≥ 6 entries). ≤ −0.12 adds 10 pts.
Klesání nad 10% sklonem za 7 dní vs. obv: Descent above a 10% gradient over 7 days vs a usual week.
Klesání za 7 dní vs. obvyklý týden. Exce: Descent over 7 days vs a usual week. Eccentric quadriceps load.
Kolísání HRV se ztrácí a týdenní průměr: HRV fluctuation is disappearing and the weekly average is falling.
Méně než {} běhy a {} min týdně za posle: Fewer than {0} runs and {1} min a week over the last 4 weeks. A less trained body needs a smaller jump — the safety margins narrow (×{2}, even more with an injury history).
Nejnáročnější běh 7 dní vs. vaše prokáza: Hardest run in 7 days vs your proven capacity (× the day's readiness). Points above +10 %: up to 1.3× mild, up to 2× moderate, above 2× high. Weight {0}.
The hardest run is {0} vs 30 days.
Nejnáročnější běh vs. nejnáročnější za p: Hardest run vs the hardest in the previous 30 days (distance or intensity). The strongest single risk signal. Bands: >1.3 mild, >2.0 (+100 %) marked.
Nejrychlejší běh za 7 dní (s přepočtem n: Fastest run in 7 days (adjusted for elevation, excluding races) vs your usual fastest runs over 2 months. A different mechanism from distance (Achilles/sole/shin).
Neustupující bolest mezi běhy (back-to-b: Pain not subsiding between runs (back-to-back). ≥ 2 adds a strong bonus.
Nevstřebaná zátěž (týdenní ekvivalent, v: Unabsorbed load (weekly equivalent, absorbed night by night) vs your weekly capacity (× readiness). Points above +15 %. Weight {0}.
Noční HRV, klidový tep, spánek a check-i: Overnight HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and check-in (70–100 %). Lowers capacity — the same run after a bad night is a larger share of capacity. The shift recalculates all the ratios below.
OSTRC: účast, objem nebo výkon omezené a: OSTRC: participation, volume or performance limited at least moderately (≥ 17). An active injury is a safety rule outside the model — it sets the risk to at least “watch”, capped at “high”.
Objem vysoké intenzity za 7 dní. Brána p: High-intensity volume over 7 days. Gate for the jump in high intensity (must be ≥ 60).
Odchylka HRV od baseline. Potlačená HRV: HRV deviation from baseline. Suppressed HRV (z ≤ −1) = fatigue/overload. Also enters the load×capacity interaction.
Odchylka klidového tepu od baseline. Zvý: Resting heart rate deviation from baseline. Elevated (z ≥ 1.2) = load/illness. Also enters the load×capacity interaction.
Recurrence at the same spot in 28 days.
Opakování na stejném místě za 28 dní. ≥: Recurrence at the same spot in 28 days. ≥ 3 adds a bonus (milder than back-to-back).
Marked site of a previous injury.
Creeping increase two weeks in a row.
Podíl běhů, kdy runner při ztuhlých noho: Share of runs where the runner still trained hard despite stiff legs (RPE ≥ 6). ≥ 0.5 adds points.
Poměr akutní:chronické tvrdé práce. Prud: Acute:chronic ratio of hard work. Sharp increase in intensity on a low base. Applies only when hard work ≥ 60.
Posun symetrie kontaktu vlevo/vpravo v p: Shift in left/right contact symmetry in percentage points. Dead zone 0.4, ceiling 3, weight 22.
Počet dní s bolestí (jakékoli místo) za: Number of days with pain (any spot) in 28 days. A more sensitive (less specific) signal than recurrence.
Prospáno / v posteli. Pod 0,85 = roztříš: Asleep / in bed. Below 0.85 = fragmented sleep.
Prudké snížení objemu — riziko při návra: Sharp reduction in volume — risk on return.
Sharp increase in speed vs usual pace.
Prudký nárůst tvrdé práce na nízké zákla: Sharp increase in hard work on a low base.
Průměr/SD denní zátěže. Počítá se jen sp: Mean/SD of daily load. Counts only together with load above capacity (Capacity engine: total 7-day load above capacity; Standard: 7:28 ratio above 1.15) — regularity alone doesn't raise risk.
Průměrný rozdíl tepu proti vaší normě pr: Average heart-rate difference vs your norm for the pace (adjusted for elevation) over the last 3–4 runs, excluding hot and very hilly ones. A divergence between internal and external load is often a sign of fatigue.
Recidiva ve stejné oblasti — v literatuř: Recurrence in the same area — the strongest risk factor in the literature (+8 pts).
Roste-li rozpad techniky v poslední třet: Whether technique breakdown in the last third of the run grows from run to run.
Rozptyl mechaniky kolem vlastní normy vs: Spread of mechanics around your own norm vs before — early neuromuscular fatigue.
Self-report únavy v check-inu. Předchází: Self-reported fatigue in the check-in. Precedes a drop in HRV/RHR.
Skok v zátěži padá na oslabenou regenera: The jump in load falls on weakened recovery.
The same spot repeatedly within ~2 days.
Heart rate at usual pace above the norm.
Tep se v druhé půli odpojuje od tempa —: Heart rate decouples from pace in the second half — cardiovascular drift.
Heart rate decouples from pace in the second half.
A week without easy days above capacity.
Týden bez lehkých dnů při rostoucí zátěž: A week without easy days with rising load.
Zbytkové riziko z velkého skoku před 1–4: Residual risk from a big jump 1–4 weeks ago (fades linearly to 28 days).
Zranění omezuje účast, objem nebo výkon: Injury limits participation, volume or performance
Základ: 1–2 → 8 b., 3–5 → 26 b., ≥6 → 44: Base: 1–2 → 8 pts, 3–5 → 26 pts, ≥6 → 44 pts. Localisation/recurrence adds a bonus below.
Load elevated just before the race.
Zátěžová osa se počítá až s dostatečnou: The load axis is calculated only with enough history. Off = some load signals don't apply.
Závažnost aktivního zranění. Bezpečnostn: Severity of the active injury. A safety rule outside the calibrated model: the points are only indicative (physio ×0.5, self-report ×0.34) and don't shift the score — the risk stays at least at “watch”.
−1 = žádné. Do 12 měsíců výrazně, do 24: −1 = none. Up to 12 months markedly, up to 24 months mildly raises frailty; adds no points by itself. Weights the signal “Pain at the site of a previous injury”.
−1 = žádný závod. Blízký závod (≤ 21 dní: −1 = no race. An upcoming race (≤ 21 days) adds weight only when load is already elevated.
2025 metaanalýza 46 studií ukázala, že p: A 2025 meta-analysis of 46 studies showed that a ratio between 1.3 and 1.5 carries only a mildly increased risk compared with middle values — hence a lower point weight than for the clearly elevated band above 1.5.
Aproximace — schéma platformy nemá čas u: Approximation — the platform's schema has no sleep onset/wake times, only sleep duration, so this is duration variability, not a true sleep regularity index. The evidence is extrapolated, not direct.
Bez tepu se nepočítá. Zóny závisí na odh: Not calculated without heart rate. Zones depend on the estimate of maximum heart rate (from your hardest runs and age, Tanaka 2001) — an estimate from average heart rate is rougher than a histogram.
Bilance se vrátí nad práh po týdnu sníže: The balance returns above the threshold after a week of reduced load.
Buď zátěžové skóre klesne pod práh, nebo: Either the load score falls below the threshold, or the race takes place / the date moves.
Běžec, jehož technika drží 90 minut, je: A runner whose technique holds for 90 minutes is more resilient than one whose vertical ratio worsens by 8 % in the last third. A rising trend across comparable runs means declining fatigue resistance.
Běžec, který je celý život na 47,5/52,5,: A runner who has been at 47.5/52.5 all their life is not a finding. The interesting one is who has just shifted there.
CV = SD(HRV, 7 dní) / průměr(HRV, 7 dní): CV = SD(HRV, 7 days) / mean(HRV, 7 days) × 100 ratio = CV_now / CV_baseline (28 days)
Chladnější podmínky a týden nižší intenz: Cooler conditions and a week of lower intensity.
Citlivé na obuv. Přechod do vyšší tlumen: Sensitive to footwear. Switching to a higher, cushioned shoe lengthens GCT without any pathology — you need to ask, not just measure.
Cíl a termín se nikde v aplikaci nepouží: The goal and date are not used anywhere in the app as the primary frame — they are an informational footnote. This signal is the exception: the combination of an upcoming race with load that is already elevated is exactly the situation in which runners most often push on with training despite the signals instead of easing off.
A day without pain ≥ 3/10 at this spot.
Doba kontaktu se zemí roste s únavou — m: Ground contact time grows with fatigue — it rises measurably from the 10th kilometre of a long run, together with a higher hip extension moment and adduction angle. A persistently higher value at the same pace and cadence suggests that fatigue isn't being cleared between sessions.
Doplňuje signál 'desc' o skutečný sklon: Complements the 'desc' signal with the actual gradient instead of just total metres. Eccentric muscle damage grows non-linearly with steepness — a gentle descent and a technical drop with the same total elevation are not mechanically the same. This signal distinguishes them where the data allow it (an elevation profile by segments, not just the sum of ascent/descent).
Doznívá lineárně do nuly 28 dní po skoku: Fades linearly to zero 28 days after the jump.
Dva až tři regenerační týdny obvykle vrá: Two to three recovery weeks usually bring GCT back to baseline. If not, it is more likely a change in technique or footwear.
Frandsen 2025: recidiva stejného místa j: Frandsen 2025: recurrence at the same spot is rare before an injury (6.9 % within 7 days), but a problem at ANY spot preceded 39.6 % of injuries within 28 days — a broader tally is a more sensitive (if less specific) warning than recurrence at the same spot alone.
GCT_adj = GCT × (kadence / baseline_kade: GCT_adj = GCT × (cadence / baseline_cadence), converted to your usual pace z = (GCT_adj − baseline) / SD [14 days]
HI zátěž = TRIMP session, kde ⌀ tep ≥ 80: HI load = session TRIMP where ⌀ heart rate ≥ 80 % of HR reserve (≈ threshold / Z4+) hiRatio = EWMA(HI, 7) / max(EWMA(HI, 28), 0.15·chronic) · signal > 1.5
HRV reaguje na nemoc, alkohol, cestování: HRV reacts to illness, alcohol, travel and work stress just as it does to training. Without context from the check-in it gets overestimated.
HRV za 7 dní ≥ 1,5 SD nad normou + únava: HRV over 7 days ≥ 1.5 SD above the norm + fatigue or a higher heart rate at pace
Hranice 1,3/1,5 jsou převzaté z agregátn: The 1.3/1.5 limits are taken from aggregate evidence across sports, not calibrated specifically to a running cohort.
Jako přímý prediktor zranění slabý — pro: Weak as a direct predictor of injury — so it only fine-tunes the score, it doesn't form it. Strongly affected by heat and dehydration.
Jeden opravdu volný den v týdnu monotónn: One truly free day a week knocks monotony down without changing anything in total load. The signal is sensitive to how the runner plans, not just how much they run.
Jednotlivé varovné příznaky mají samy o: Individual warning signs have weak predictive value on their own; the doctor's clinical judgement decides. The app determines nothing; it only pauses training and refers you to a doctor.
Kapacitu tkáně nelze měřit přímo; defici: Tissue capacity can't be measured directly; the deficit is only an indirect proxy from recovery markers.
Když HRV klesne k normě nebo únava odezn: When HRV drops to the norm or the fatigue fades.
Když jednotlivý trénink i týdenní součet: When both a single session and the weekly total fall below your capacity.
Když minuty v Z4+ jednoho běhu i týdne k: When the minutes in Z4+ of a single run and of the week fall below your proven capacity.
When one of the components fades.
Když průměr posledních běhů klesne pod 6: When the average of the last runs falls below 6 beats.
Klasický ACWR má vážné problémy: teoreti: The classic ACWR has serious problems: its theoretical basis lacks robust evidence, the ratios collapse at low chronic load and findings across studies contradict each other. The well-known “sweet spot” figure was published only as an illustration and then repeatedly reprinted as if it were validated. Even the 2025 meta-analysis speaks only of a “mildly increased” risk, not a sharp limit — hence a two-step band instead of a single threshold.
Klesající subjektivní pocit z běhu při n: A declining subjective feeling from runs at unchanged load is often the first thing a runner notices — before pain.
Klesá každou noc bez běhu, jak se zátěž: Falls every night without running as the load is absorbed. It disappears when the unabsorbed load falls below capacity (+ reserve).
Lineární rozpad je zjednodušení; skutečn: Linear decay is a simplification; the actual tissue recovery time is individual.
Mechanika se mění bez nárůstu objemu. To: Mechanics change without an increase in volume. Purely volume-based apps can't see this.
Mechanistická úvaha. Generuje hypotézu,: Mechanistic reasoning. Generates a hypothesis, nothing more.
Metaanalýzy a běžecké kohorty ukazují, ž: Meta-analyses and running cohorts show that even small but repeated two-week increases in load precede injury — not just big jumps. It catches a creeping increase that the 7:28 ratio doesn't yet flag.
Místo na mapě těla neodliší kost od sval: A spot on the body map can't distinguish bone from muscle or tendon, so this is a precautionary rule.
Měření spánku z hodinek je nepřesné, zvl: Sleep measurement from the watch is imprecise, especially for stages. That's why the value can be overwritten manually.
Nad zhruba 5 % na aerobním běhu naznačuj: Above roughly 5 % on an aerobic run it suggests unresolved fatigue. Established in endurance monitoring.
Nad ~85 % po několika nocích klidnějšího: Above ~85 % after a few nights of calmer sleep.
Nespecifické. Rozlišit infekt od přetíže: Non-specific. An infection can't be told apart from overload without more data — so it is tied to the check-in.
Nižší kadence při srovnatelném tempu zna: A lower cadence at a comparable pace means a longer stride and longer ground contact — associated with higher impact and braking force. A drop vs your own norm is often an early sign of developing fatigue or a change in technique.
Nižší specificita; self-report se v hist: Lower specificity; self-report isn't replayed in the historical replay.
Návrat do ±0,5 p.b. od vlastní normy po: Return to within ±0.5 pp of your own norm for 14 days.
Return to within ±1 SD after three nights.
Návrat k baseline po dvou až třech dnech: Return to baseline after two to three days.
Návrat kadence k vlastní normě po několi: Cadence returns to your own norm after several runs in comparable conditions.
Návrat oscilace k vlastní normě po odleh: Oscillation returns to your own norm after easing off or adding strength work.
Návrat po přetížení kosti se řídí úplnou: Return after bone overload is guided by complete absence of pain (Warden et al., 2014), unlike tendon, where pain up to 5/10 is tolerated (Silbernagel et al., 2007).
Observační evidence — strop je ochranné: Observational evidence — the ceiling is a protective guardrail, not a guarantee. Capacity can't be known before ~3 runs in 30 days (week: ~4 weeks of history).
Odborný komentář, ne systematický přehle: Expert commentary, not a systematic review. The app determines nothing; it only refers you to a physiotherapist.
Opírá se o malé studie, HRV reaguje i na: Based on small studies; HRV also reacts to many influences outside training.
Po návratu klesání pod vaši kapacitu; po: After descent returns below your capacity; gradually adding hills raises capacity.
After ascent returns below your capacity.
Po odpovědi „ne“ v dalším check-inu (pla: After answering “no” in the next check-in (applies today and tomorrow).
Po týdnu stabilního nebo sníženého objem: After a week of stable or reduced volume.
Pokles HRV proti vlastní normě je zavede: A drop in HRV vs your own norm is an established marker of incomplete recovery and autonomic stress. It is used as a modulator of the load axis, not as a standalone reason to intervene.
Poměr HI zátěže se vrátí k ~1 po pár dne: The HI load ratio returns to ~1 after a few days without hard runs.
Poměr klesne pod 1,2 po dvou týdnech pra: The ratio falls below 1.2 after two weeks of a more regular routine.
Poměr klesne pod 1,2 po týdnu pravidelné: The ratio falls below 1.2 after a week of regular measurement.
Poměr klesne pod 1,3 po týdnu stabilizov: The ratio falls below 1.3 after a week of stabilised volume.
Poměr se vrátí do 0,7–1,3 po dvou týdnec: The ratio returns to 0.7–1.3 after two weeks of stable volume.
Prahy jsou pracovní předpoklady, ne vali: The thresholds are working assumptions, not validated criteria.
Prudké zrychlení je jiný mechanismus než: A sharp increase in speed is a different mechanism from an increase in distance — Nielsen 2014 maps pace jumps more to the Achilles / plantar fascia / shin, while distance maps to the knee/shin.
Prudký nárůst tvrdé práce na nízké chron: A sharp increase in hard work on a low chronic base of hard work is, according to the team's evidence, riskier than the same increase in total load at easy intensity. It separates intensity from mere volume.
Předchozí zranění je konzistentně nejsil: A previous injury is consistently the strongest predictor of further injury across studies.
Předchozí zranění je nejrobustnější rizi: A previous injury is the most robust risk factor across the literature (Hulme 2017; van Poppel 2021); recurrence in the same area is its strongest manifestation.
Retrospektivní a subjektivní. Běžci před: Retrospective and subjective. Before a race, runners systematically underestimate it.
Riziko zranění po prudkém nárůstu zátěže: Injury risk after a sharp increase in load peaks 1–4 weeks AFTER it, not on the day of the jump (IOC consensus 2016; the effect lasts up to a month). The status therefore stays elevated until the adaptation catches up.
Roste-li rozptyl kontaktu se zemí kolem: If the spread of ground contact around your own norm grows from run to run, it is often an early signal of neuromuscular fatigue or compensation — it shows up before the average shifts. Gait variability is an established marker in movement pathology.
Rozchod mezi vnitřní a vnější zátěží býv: A divergence between internal and external load is often a sign of fatigue (Bourdon et al., 2017; Halson, 2014).
Rozptyl se vrátí k baseline po pár konzi: The spread returns to baseline after a few consistent runs in comparable conditions.
Roztříštěný spánek (nízká efektivita, WA: Fragmented sleep (low efficiency, WASO) is associated with a higher risk of musculoskeletal injury beyond the number of hours slept — cohorts of adolescents and elite athletes.
SD_teď = SD(délka spánku, 14 dní) SD_bas: SD_now = SD(sleep duration, 14 days) SD_baseline = SD(sleep duration, 35 days before that) ratio = SD_now / SD_baseline
Sbíhání je hlavní zdroj excentrického po: Downhill running is the main source of eccentric muscle damage. For the trail part of the cohort, total distance is misleading: 20 km on the flat and 20 km with 900 m of descent are the same numbers and very different mechanical loads.
Sebehodnocená bolest je nejsilnější jedn: Self-reported pain is the strongest single predictor and the only grade A signal the platform has continuously available. Biomechanics complements it, it doesn't replace it.
Sebehodnocená bolest zůstává nejsilnější: Self-reported pain remains the strongest single predictor. Repeated reporting of the same spot after sessions is clinically more significant than a one-off high value in the weekly check-in, because it captures a pattern tied to a specific type of load.
Seběh je excentrická zátěž: nárazové síl: Downhill running is an eccentric load: impact forces grow with gradient (Gottschall & Kram 2005) and muscle damage is greatest at the first unfamiliar dose — repeated exposure protects (repeated-bout effect, McHugh 2003). That's why it is measured against YOUR recent descent dose, not in absolute terms.
Sekundární analýza randomizované studie: A secondary analysis of a randomised trial with more than 800 recreational runners showed that gait asymmetry in spatial and kinetic variables doesn't increase the risk of lower-limb injury. The often-cited figure of a 75% injury rate above 10 % asymmetry comes from military basic training and doesn't transfer to recreational runners. The platform therefore doesn't flag absolute asymmetry — only its change vs your own norm. Subtle shifts in asymmetry, including a reversal of the ratio of reaction forces between limbs, have been observed before bone stress injury in collegiate runners.
Signál zmizí, když se VR ve stejných pod: The signal disappears when VR returns to within ±1 SD under the same conditions for three sessions.
Silně závislá na typu tréninku v předcho: Strongly dependent on the type of training in the preceding days.
Skok v délce jednoho běhu proti nejdelší: A jump in single-run distance vs the longest run of the previous 30 days is a dose-dependent risk factor in a cohort of 5,205 runners (Frandsen 2025); a sharp weekly increase (> 30 %) is linked to some types of injury (Nielsen 2014). Capacity is what you have demonstrably managed without problems.
Smíšená nebo vznikající evidence — signá: Mixed or emerging evidence — a signal, not proof.
Spánek pod vlastní normou opakovaně sniž: Sleep repeatedly below your own norm lowers load tolerance and impairs soft-tissue recovery.
Stabilní nebo rostoucí trend po dvou týd: A stable or rising trend after two weeks.
Stejné příznaky mohou mít mnoho příčin (: The same symptoms can have many causes (load, sleep, stress, nutrition, illness), so it pays to discuss them with a professional rather than looking for a single cause (Jeukendrup et al., 2024).
Stoupání zvyšuje zatížení lýtka a Achill: Climbing increases the load on the calf and Achilles tendon and the metabolic demand (Minetti 2002).
Stupeň C — jde o rozšíření zavedeného HR: Grade C — an extension of the established HRV signal with a new axis, not a separately prospectively validated metric. Sensitive to irregular measurement (missed nights).
Stupeň C — logická kombinace dvou alread: Grade C — a logical combination of two already existing signals (date + load), not a separately validated predictor. It doesn't assess the quality of the training plan, only its timing.
Stupeň C — mechanistická úvaha, ne prosp: Grade C — mechanistic reasoning, not a prospectively validated threshold. With real data it depends on the density of GPS/elevation records in the export; with demo data the profile is synthesised from the run's actual total elevation, not measured.
Stupeň C — nejslabší kanál, proto nejniž: Grade C — the weakest channel, hence the lowest weight.
Stupeň C — plíživý nárůst je normální so: Grade C — a creeping increase is a normal part of building fitness; it is risky mainly in combination with suppressed recovery or symptoms. On its own it is not a reason to intervene.
Stupeň C — čistě subjektivní, kolísá s n: Grade C — purely subjective, varies with mood and context. Supplementary, not a standalone reason to intervene.
Stupeň C, čistě sebehodnocené. Závisí na: Grade C, purely self-rated. It depends on how honestly and regularly the runner fills in the ratings, and how well they can tell stiffness from muscle soreness.
Stupeň C. Kadence přirozeně kolísá s tem: Grade C. Cadence naturally varies with pace and terrain — so it is compared only within matching profiles, not against a population norm. Stride length is the other side of the same coin, so it isn't counted separately.
Stupeň C. Mechanisticky dává smysl, pros: Grade C. It makes mechanistic sense; prospective validation for injury risk is weak. Sensitive to pace and terrain — hence per profile.
Stupeň C. Mechanisticky to dává smysl, p: Grade C. It makes mechanistic sense; there is no prospective validation. At the same time it is the metric that moves first.
Stupeň C. Ovlivněno počasím, motivací i: Grade C. Affected by the weather, motivation and how the last race went.
Stupeň C: silný mechanismus, málo prospe: Grade C: a strong mechanism, few prospective injury data. Without an elevation profile the gradient is estimated from your other runs.
